mapper.select:
SELECT a.`device_id` `deviceId`, a.`device_name` `deviceName`, a.`code` `deviceCode`, b.`gear_position_code` `gearPositionCode`, b.`gear_position_id` `gearPositionId`, b.`gear_position_name` `gearPositionName`, b.`gear_position_area` `gearPositionArea`, b.`unit_traffic` `unitTraffic`, b.`unit_price` `unitPrice`, b.`emplace_temperature` `emplaceTemperature` FROM `security_device` a LEFT JOIN `device_position` b ON a.`device_id` = b.`cold_water_device` where a.`application_code` = 'COOLINGWATER'
and (b.`gear_position_name` like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or a.`code` like concat('%',#{keyword},'%'))

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(${dataColumn}),0) FROM ${tableName} where
`data_time` between #{startTime} and #{endTime}
and `device_code` like concat('%',#{deviceCode},'%')
and `department_id` like concat('%',#{param.department},'%')
and `gear_position_code` like concat('%',#{param.gearPositionCode},'%')
and `code` like concat('%',#{param.code},'%')
and `shift_master` like concat('%',#{param.shiftMaster},'%')

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(${dataColumn}),0) as `value`,`data_time` as `keyName` FROM ${tableName} where
`data_time` between #{startTime} and #{endTime}
and `device_code` like concat('%',#{param.deviceCode},'%')
and `department_id` like concat('%',#{param.department},'%')
and `gear_position_code` like concat('%',#{param.gearPositionCode},'%')
and `code` like concat('%',#{param.code},'%')
and `shift_master` like concat('%',#{param.shiftMaster},'%')
group by `data_time`
